sabang-x-zipline-wikipedia-omit.notes: Sabang X Zipline is a commercial adventure zipline activity at Sabang Beach, Puerto Princesa. No substantive English Wikipedia article exists for this specific zipline installation. Searched en.wikipedia.org and Wikimedia Commons Category:Sabang, Puerto Princesa — no dedicated article found. The zipline is mentioned only in passing in the Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park article as a Sabang area activity. No h1-name-match article exists to link.
